# Conflicting placed Footprint property fixtures

These small, tooling-owned schematics are synthetic and not for manufacture.
The fault repeats J1's direct placed-symbol `Footprint` property with
conflicting values. Controls cover one explicit footprint, a repeated property
with the same value, and a conflicting duplicate in the embedded library
definition while the placed instance retains one footprint. Native evidence is
pinned to KiCad 10.0.8.
